meta.name: contract-review
meta.description: Contract review skill that adds comment-based issue annotations without changing original text. Enforces a three-layer review (basic, business, legal), writes structured comments (issue type, risk reason, revision suggestion) with risk level encoded via reviewer name, and generates a contract summary, consolidated opinion, and Mermaid business flowchart (with rendered image). Output language must follow the contract’s language.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查合同并添加结构化批注与摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速审查合同条款并生成风险摘要
copy.tagline_en: Review contracts with structured annotations and summaries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly review contract clauses and generate risk summaries

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会审阅合同文件，只添加批注而不修改原文。它会进行三层审查（基础、商业、法律），生成带风险等级的批注、合同概要、综合意见和业务流程图。
howto.when: 当你上传一份合同文件（.docx）并请求审阅时触发。

say.text: 请审阅这份合同，给出批注和概要。
say.note: Claude 会执行三层审查并输出所有文件。

say.text: 检查合同中的数字和日期是否一致。
say.note: 触发基础层审查，关注文本质量。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reviews contract documents by adding comments only, without altering the original text. It performs a three-layer review (basic, business, legal), generates structured comments with risk levels, a contract summary, a consolidated opinion, and a business flowchart.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you upload a contract file (.docx) and request a review.

say_en.text: Review this contract and provide comments and a summary.
say_en.note: Claude will perform the full three-layer review and output all files.

say_en.text: Check the contract for consistency in numbers and dates.
say_en.note: Triggers the basic layer review focusing on text quality.
